description: If \(\varphi(\bar x)\) is preserved under extensions between models of \(T\), any tuple in a model of \(T\) satisfying all existential consequences of \(\varphi\) modulo \(T\) also satisfies \(\varphi\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.existentialConsequences_entail.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {T : L.Theory}
  {n : ℕ} {φ : L.Formula (Fin n)} (hφ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.ExtensionPreserved T φ) (M : T.ModelType)
  (a : Fin n → ↑M) (ha : ∀ ψ ∈ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.existentialConsequences T φ, ψ.Realize a) :
  φ.Realize a
